indicator.description: Single indicator to add to an IOC collection. For IP address type, provide a plain IPv4 or IPv6 value (CIDR is not supported).

indicators.description: List of indicators to add to an IOC collection. For IP address type, provide plain IPv4 or IPv6 values (CIDR is not supported).

indicators_path.description: Path to an indicators file to add to an IOC collection.

ioc_collection_id.description: Identifier of the target IOC collection.

indicator_type.description: Type of indicator to add. For IP address type, only plain IPv4 or IPv6 values are supported (CIDR is not supported).
indicator_type.example: IP address, domain, url, email or hash

valid_for.description: Validity period in days for the created indicators.

description: Add indicators to an IOC collection.
name: Add IOC to IOC Collection
